reason: My AMC renewals slip because they live in a notebook and old WhatsApp chats, and customers keep asking for proper reports. Since I pay nothing unless my boys actually use it and the founder comes to my office himself, I will let it run for a month. If they don't use it, I've lost nothing.
objection: Who is this founder and will he still be around next year once I have moved all my AMC customers onto it? My technicians are used to the WhatsApp group too, and I doubt half of them will press a button after every job when the work gets heavy.
would_change_my_mind: If the founder can't give me a name of another Chennai service company already using it, or if setup takes more than one visit and starts eating my time, I will drop it.
